$comment: Self-hosted services. 'nix' is emitted verbatim. 'ports' feed the central firewall. 'secrets' are files you must create by hand before the first rebuild - the review screen lists them. Every option path here is checked against the live NixOS options index by tools/verify-options.mjs.

items.name: Jellyfin
items.desc: Media server for films, TV and music. No account, no subscription, no telemetry.
items.note: Add your libraries through the setup wizard on first launch. The UDP ports are for DLNA and client auto-discovery.

items.name: Plex
items.desc: Polished media server with first-class apps on every TV platform.

items.name: Navidrome
items.desc: Subsonic-compatible music streaming server for your own library.

items.name: Audiobookshelf
items.desc: Audiobook and podcast server that remembers where you stopped on every device.

items.name: Immich
items.desc: Self-hosted photo and video backup with mobile apps, face grouping and search.
items.note: Immich pulls in PostgreSQL with pgvecto-rs and Redis automatically. It wants a lot of RAM during machine-learning jobs.

items.name: Komga
items.desc: Comic and manga server that speaks OPDS to any reader app.

items.name: Calibre-Web
items.desc: Browser front end for a Calibre ebook library, with send-to-Kindle.
items.note: The directory must already contain a Calibre metadata.db, or the first start fails.

items.name: Sonarr
items.desc: Watches for new episodes of the shows you follow and fetches them.

items.name: Radarr
items.desc: The same idea as Sonarr, for films.

items.name: Lidarr
items.desc: Music collection manager for the *arr stack.

items.name: Prowlarr
items.desc: Single place to manage indexers, syncs them to every other *arr app.

items.name: Bazarr
items.desc: Finds and downloads subtitles for everything in your library.

items.name: Transmission
items.desc: Lightweight BitTorrent daemon with a web interface.
items.note: The RPC whitelist is disabled so you can reach the UI from the LAN. Put it behind the reverse proxy with authentication if the box is exposed.

items.name: SABnzbd
items.desc: Usenet binary downloader with a web interface.

items.name: Nextcloud
items.desc: Files, calendar, contacts and a large app ecosystem. The full private-cloud option.
items.note: Pin services.nextcloud.package to the newest version in your channel - Nextcloud only supports upgrading one major release at a time.

items.name: Syncthing
items.desc: Continuous peer-to-peer file sync between your own devices. No server in the middle.
items.note: The GUI has no password by default. Set one immediately, or bind it to 127.0.0.1 and reach it over SSH.

items.name: Samba
items.desc: SMB/CIFS shares that Windows, macOS and phones can all mount.
items.note: Create the Samba password separately with `smbpasswd -a <user>` - Linux and Samba passwords are stored independently.

items.name: Paperless-ngx
items.desc: Scans, OCRs and indexes your paper documents so you can search them.

items.name: NFS server
items.desc: Unix-native network filesystem. Faster than SMB between Linux machines.

items.name: AdGuard Home
items.desc: Network-wide DNS ad and tracker blocking for every device on the LAN.
items.note: Point your router's DHCP at this machine's IP for it to take effect network-wide.

items.name: Unbound
items.desc: Validating, recursive DNS resolver. Answers queries itself instead of trusting an upstream.

items.name: Headscale
items.desc: Self-hosted control server for Tailscale clients.

items.name: Caddy
items.desc: Web server and reverse proxy that gets HTTPS certificates automatically.
items.note: Ports 80 and 443 must be reachable from the internet for the ACME HTTP challenge to succeed.

items.name: nginx
items.desc: The classic high-performance web server and reverse proxy, with ACME wired in.

items.name: Forgejo
items.desc: Lightweight self-hosted git forge with issues, pull requests and CI.
items.note: Registration is disabled. Create the first account with `forgejo admin user create` as the forgejo user.

items.name: Gitea
items.desc: The project Forgejo forked from. Same shape, different governance.

items.name: Jenkins
items.desc: Long-standing automation server for builds and scheduled jobs.

items.name: code-server
items.desc: VS Code in the browser, running on the server.

secrets.desc: Argon2 hash of your code-server password

items.note: Replace %%ARGON2_HASH%% with the output of the command above before rebuilding.

items.name: Prometheus
items.desc: Time-series metrics database that scrapes exporters, with the node exporter enabled.

items.name: Grafana
items.desc: Dashboards for Prometheus, Loki and about eighty other data sources.
items.note: First login is admin / admin, and it will make you change it.

items.name: Uptime Kuma
items.desc: Pretty uptime monitor with notifications to almost any service.

items.name: Netdata
items.desc: Per-second metrics for everything on the box, zero configuration.

items.name: Home Assistant
items.desc: The hub for local home automation - talks to thousands of device integrations.
items.note: Setting `config` makes configuration.yaml read-only. Use `services.home-assistant.extraComponents` to add integrations that need Python dependencies.

items.name: Mosquitto
items.desc: MQTT broker - the message bus most smart-home devices speak.

secrets.desc: MQTT password for the homeassistant user

items.name: Zigbee2MQTT
items.desc: Bridges a Zigbee USB coordinator onto MQTT, no vendor hub required.
items.note: Check the real device path with `ls -l /dev/serial/by-id/` and use that stable path instead of /dev/ttyACM0.

items.name: Vaultwarden
items.desc: Lightweight Bitwarden-compatible password server. Works with all the official clients.

secrets.desc: ADMIN_TOKEN for the Vaultwarden admin page

items.note: Vaultwarden must be served over HTTPS or the browser extensions refuse to connect. Put it behind the reverse proxy.

items.name: Authelia
items.desc: Single sign-on and 2FA portal that sits in front of everything else.

secrets.desc: User database (see Authelia docs for the format)

items.name: SearXNG
items.desc: Meta search engine that queries others on your behalf and keeps no profile.

secrets.desc: SEARX_SECRET - the module substitutes it into secret_key at runtime

items.name: Miniflux
items.desc: Minimalist RSS reader. One binary, one Postgres database, no JavaScript required.

secrets.desc: ADMIN_USERNAME and ADMIN_PASSWORD, one per line

items.name: Vikunja
items.desc: To-do and project management with list, gantt and kanban views.

items.name: HedgeDoc
items.desc: Real-time collaborative markdown notes in the browser.

items.name: ntfy
items.desc: Push notifications to your phone from a shell script or curl.

items.name: Homepage
items.desc: Dashboard that links to everything else you self-host, with live service widgets.

items.name: Ollama
items.desc: Runs local language models and exposes an HTTP API on the network.
items.note: Set services.ollama.acceleration to "cuda" or "rocm" to use the GPU. Without it everything runs on the CPU.

items.name: Open WebUI
items.desc: Chat interface for Ollama and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

items.name: PostgreSQL
items.desc: The default relational database for most self-hosted software.
items.note: Left listening on the Unix socket only. Turn on enableTCPIP and open port 5432 if something off-box needs it.

items.name: MariaDB
items.desc: MySQL-compatible relational database.

items.name: Redis
items.desc: In-memory key-value store used as a cache by many of these services.

items.name: Minecraft server
items.desc: Vanilla Minecraft server, declaratively configured.
items.note: Setting eula = true records that you accept Mojang's end user licence agreement.

items.name: CUPS printing
items.desc: Printing, with driverless IPP discovery over the network.
items.note: Driverless IPP discovery needs mDNS, so this pulls in Avahi as well.

items.name: restic backups
items.desc: Nightly encrypted, deduplicated backups of the directories you care about.

secrets.desc: Repository encryption password - if you lose this the backups are unreadable

items.note: A backup on the same machine is not a backup. Point the repository at another host, or an S3/B2 bucket.

items.name: Avahi / mDNS
items.desc: Makes the machine reachable as hostname.local and finds other devices on the LAN.

items.name: Deluge
items.desc: BitTorrent client with a separate web UI daemon.

items.name: Gotify
items.desc: Simple self-hosted push notification server with an Android app.
items.note: First login is admin / admin. Change it immediately.

items.name: FreshRSS
items.desc: Fast, self-hosted RSS aggregator with a mobile-friendly reader.
items.note: This module sets up its own nginx virtual host, so it wants to own port 80.

items.name: Mealie
items.desc: Recipe manager and meal planner that can import recipes from a URL.

items.name: Actual Budget
items.desc: Local-first envelope budgeting with end-to-end encrypted sync.

items.name: Stirling PDF
items.desc: Local web toolkit for splitting, merging, OCR-ing and converting PDFs.

items.name: n8n
items.desc: Visual workflow automation - connect APIs together without writing glue code.
